findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "certscore_get_scan_bundle" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "light" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: certscore_get_scan_status, certscore_get_scan_bundle · Public sink: certscore_get_scan_bundle.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: certscore_get_scan_status, certscore_get_scan_bundle · Public sink: certscore_get_scan_bundle

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
